description: Dark universe with twinkling stars and slowly drifting nebulae.
The Sun with a glowing asymmetric corona, animated plasma loops, and occasional large eruptions.
Lascaux cave paintings with flickering warm lamplight and subtle camera movement.
Illustrated Hypatia observing the starry sky, surrounded by astronomical instruments, scrolls, geometric drawings, and an oil lamp.
Detailed antique geocentric celestial map with Earth at the centre, moving planets, zodiac divisions, lunar phases, and engraved ornaments.
Slowly rotating constellation wheel crossing the middle of the screen, with three or four zodiac constellations visible at a time.
Cinematic Earth from space with detailed continents, oceans, clouds, atmospheric rim lighting, and gentle camera movement.
Cinematic Moon from space with detailed craters, lunar maria, soft shadows, and subtle camera movement.
Cinematic Mars from space with detailed surface features and its two orbiting moons, Phobos and Deimos.
Martian surface with rocky terrain, rust-coloured dunes, drifting dust, and a pale setting Sun surrounded by a blue glow.
Animated solar system with the Sun, all eight planets, orbital paths, Saturn’s rings, Earth’s Moon, and the asteroid belt. Sizes, distances, and speeds are illustrative.
